name: Media
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Media, PA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Media, Pennsylvania for 2026: Santa's Parade, Rose Tree Festival of Lights and Linvilla Orchards, with dates checked.
lede: Media kicks off the season with Santa's Parade through the borough and sends families to Rose Tree Park for a walk through more than 300,000 lights, with Linvilla Orchards close by.
celebrates: Media is the county seat of Delaware County and calls itself Everybody's Hometown, according to Wikipedia. Visit Media PA lists Santa's Parade for Sunday, November 29, 2026, with a Holiday Block Party in the borough from 2:30 pm, and says the parade officially announces the arrival of the holiday season. Delaware County Parks and Recreation runs the Festival of Lights at Rose Tree Park just outside the borough, a walk-through display with free admission and parking. Nearby Swarthmore adds its own Home for the Holidays day with a historical trolley ride, and Linvilla Orchards sits on West Knowlton Road.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap of the Media parade, so this page leans on the hosts' own 2026 listings. Visit Media PA describes Santa's Parade as an annual tradition led by the big man in the red suit. Delaware County says the Festival of Lights is a tradition of more than fifty years that draws about 100,000 visitors every year, and it asks families to call 610-891-4455 for weather cancellation messages before they head out.
facts: Media was incorporated in 1850, the same year it was named the county seat of Delaware County, and the 2020 census counted 5,991 residents, according to Wikipedia. The borough sits about 13 miles west of Philadelphia. Wikipedia also notes that trolley lines spread to and through Media in the 1890s and early 1900s, and that electrified service opened on December 2, 1928. Delaware County says the Rose Tree Festival of Lights uses more than 300,000 twinkling lights.
trains: Media has a rail and trolley past. Wikipedia says trolley lines reached Media in the 1890s and early 1900s, and electrified service opened on December 2, 1928. For Christmas trains, the closest option for most families is Santa's Express at the West Chester Railroad, which our West Chester guide covers with dates and prices. Swarthmore's Home for the Holidays adds a historical trolley ride on December 5, which this page lists.
train_links: The heritage railroad that runs Santa's Express and the Christmas Tree Train, listed on our museum guide.

faq: How does Media, PA celebrate Christmas?

Visit Media PA lists Santa's Parade on Sunday, November 29, with a Holiday Block Party starting at 2:30 pm. Delaware County also runs the Festival of Lights at Rose Tree Park, a free walk-through display with more than 300,000 lights.
Is the Media Santa Parade free?
Yes. Visit Media PA lists the cost as free, and the borough's block party before the parade is part of the same afternoon.
Is the Rose Tree Festival of Lights free?
Yes. Delaware County says admission and parking are free, and it welcomes donations to help cover costs.
Where can kids see Christmas lights near Media?
Rose Tree Park on North Providence Road hosts the county's Festival of Lights, and Linvilla Orchards on West Knowlton Road runs Christmasland.
intro_html:

We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
